name: ontology_v2_moons
description: Ontology v2 schema migration + monthly moon data load. Adds confidence, source, version, belief-tracking fields to all OntologyTerm nodes. Loads 21 new Lunar category terms (12 monthly moons with cross-cultural definitions from 10 traditions, 8 special moon types, 1 parent grouping). Wires PART_OF and RELATED_TO relationships.
author: Ka'tuar'el + Claude

neo4j: Migrated 71 existing OntologyTerm nodes to v2 schema
Created PART_OF and RELATED_TO relationships for moon terms
New subcategories: Monthly Moons, Special Moons
other: No service restarts required — Neo4j data only + docs

rollback: echo 'MATCH (t:OntologyTerm {batch_id: "moon_terms_2026-02-23"}) DETACH DELETE t;' | cypher-shell -u neo4j -p $NEO4J_PASSWORD
